_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 30d momentum and funding neutral keep score in Hope band; coil base rate favors HOLD until fear_greed or range actually breaks.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both cautionary, but analyst explicit HOLD/Hope vs narrative inflow-supply pressure without a phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, fear_greed ~55-70, 30d momentum near 50
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed >71 with momentum expansion (Optimism) or <54 on range break with extreme inflows (Disbelief)
